name: Barefoot Telecom
summary: Northern Rivers NSW local telco (Barefoot Telecom, ABN active 2009) offering landline/mobile/internet; from ~Mar 2015 the Barefoot Telecom name was held by MATE Communicate (formerly Orofino), and barefoottelecom.com.au now redirects to MATE's site - confirmed link to MATE.

events.details: Northern Rivers NSW telco (landline, mobile, internet).
Barefoot Telecom name taken over by MATE Communicate; brand folded into MATE (~2018).
Business name 'Barefoot Telecom' (held by MATE Communicate Pty Ltd ABN 33 165 670 413 from 12 Mar 2015) deregistered 26 Jul 2018; barefoottelecom.com.au now redirects to MATE.
